example.title: Net shed on pilings in the Columbia River (Uniontown)

brief: A lone gillnetter's net loft on pilings out in the river: a two-storey shed of weathered red-brown vertical boards with a low red metal gable roof, small square windows, a lean-to on the shore side and a narrow plank catwalk on piles back to the bank, surrounded by rows of old stub piles. One photo. Older than 1970: net lofts on piles are a pre-war type with no newer examples. Piles carried 10 m below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).
